styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Ybor City, the Tampa Museum of Art and the Riverwalk.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Cuban sandwiches, deviled crab and Gulf seafood.

styles.label: Beaches
styles.blurb: Clearwater and St. Pete beaches, an easy drive west.

stays.why: Walk to the Riverwalk, museums and arenas. Streetcar to Ybor is free.
Historic cigar district with bars and Cuban food. Livelier at night, quieter by day.
Waterfront near the Florida Aquarium and cruise terminal. Short walk to downtown.
Closest to the airport and the big mall. Good for early flights and rental cars.

food: Get a Cuban sandwich at a Ybor City lunch counter. Expect pressed pork, ham and pickles for roughly $10–15.
Try deviled crab and Spanish bean soup at old Ybor cafeterias. Budget about $10–20 a plate.
Gulf seafood is the local pick: grouper, stone crab in season and shrimp. Prices vary; check the day's catch.
Food halls and Riverwalk cafés are easy for mixed groups. Expect $15–25 a main.
Summer heat is strong. Drink water often and plan a long indoor lunch during afternoon storms.
more_time: Add a beach day: drive west to Clearwater or St. Pete Beach, roughly 40–60 minutes. Check traffic on the bridges.
Busch Gardens Tampa Bay fills a full day for thrill rides and animals. Check ticket prices and opening hours on the day.
Swap a city afternoon for the Florida Aquarium or a Tampa Bay history museum if it rains.

recommend.why: Two nights covers Ybor, the Riverwalk and a beach day. Add a night if you want Busch Gardens or a slow Gulf sunset.

month_notes: January: cool and dry, highs near 21°C. Bring a light jacket for evenings.
February: mild and dry, highs near 23°C. Good walking weather.
March: warming to 26°C with about 7 rain days. Pleasant for beaches.
April: warm at 28°C and fairly dry. Strong sun; use sunscreen.
May: hot at 31°C and wetter, about 11 rain days. Plan indoor breaks.
June: hot and very wet, about 22 rain days. Afternoon storms are common.
July: hottest and wettest, about 27 rain days. Carry a rain jacket.
August: same heat and heavy rain, about 26 rain days. Mornings are best.
September: still hot and wet, about 20 rain days. Watch for storms.
October: cooling to 28°C and drier, about 9 rain days. Good all-round month.
November: mild at 25°C and dry, about 6 rain days. Comfortable for sightseeing.
December: cool and dry, highs near 23°C. Light layers help at night.

climate_guide.summary: Subtropical and humid. Mild, dry winters and hot, stormy summers with heavy afternoon rain.

items.title: Best time: November to April
items.text: Highs of 21–28°C with few rain days. Ideal for walking, beaches and outdoor sights.

items.title: Summer is hot and humid (June to September)
items.text: Highs near 31°C and lows near 24–25°C. Plan outdoor time for early morning.

items.title: Heavy summer rain
items.text: June to September brings 20–27 rain days a month, often short afternoon storms. Keep plans flexible.

items.title: Pack a rain jacket in summer
items.text: Storms pass quickly but soak you. An umbrella or light rain shell helps.

items.title: Beach days are best in spring and fall
items.text: April, May, October and November give warm water with less rain. Check conditions on the day.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light clothes, a hat and strong sunscreen. Add a light layer for winter evenings and indoor AC.

transit.best: Ride apps or a rental car for most trips; the free streetcar for downtown and Ybor.

modes.text: No metro or train inside the city. Don't plan around rail.
HART buses cover Hillsborough County, about $1.75 local and $2.75 commuter express. PSTA buses serve Pinellas County and connect the airport to downtown Tampa.
Uber and Lyft operate. Taxis are metered; book by app or phone.
Driving is convenient but rush hours (7:30–9:30AM, 3:30–7:30PM) are slow, especially on I-275.
Downtown is walkable. Bikes and scooters work for short trips, but summer heat is strong.
TECO Line Streetcar is fare-free and links downtown to Ybor City, roughly every 20 min.
